description:
Compile-time annotation-processor bundle that every Vidocq runtime module
        needs (Vauban indexer — CDI bean discovery). Consumed via
        <annotationProcessorPaths> in maven-compiler-plugin; Maven resolves
        the transitive dependencies declared below into APT paths automatically.
        Wired by default through the pluginManagement of vidocq-runtime-parent (applications)
        and vidocq-runtime-build (this reactor), so modules inherit it without restating anything.
